trails.note: Followed the thin cat track that carries the pink uphill route and every Northway label. From the summit (Sky Haus ~(2050,122)) down the narrow east-ridge strip beside the orange boundary to the Flyer top junction (2244,358) (the SIDE VIEW inset shows Northway leaving the summit down this ridge; Ullr's Dream takes the parallel strip nearer the boundary, symbol (2296,317)); then the long traverse west past the squares at (2209,397) and (2051,519) (the task's centre (2194,458) is the mean of these two printed labels, (2272,397) and (2115,519)) and (1636,575), to the Catwalk junction (1300,622); down-left to the hook where Angel's Wiggle leaves (1128,686); past the square (1027,724) and the top of Purgatory (~(986,748)); then down the wide open band west of Hell's Woods past the lower label (its PDF symbol is a diamond, at (784,953)) to where it merges into Paradise Meadows (~(820,1066); Paradise Meadows' square (816,1084) sits at the merge). Only the summit-to-Flyer-top ridge is not directly labelled on the main map.

Printed twice: squares at (1004,827) and (944,980) (the task's single centre (1062,904) is the mean of the two printed labels (1092,827) and (1032,980)). Traced from the Northway band (~(955,776)) down the narrow open strip on the west side of the thin diagonal tree row that separates it from Purgatory's channel, past the upper symbol at the row's tip, across the west end of the wide open band below the Purgatory/Hell's Crossing tree island (where Angel's Wiggle comes in from the east), then down the open strip along the east edge of Hell's Woods (pink uphill route on it) past the lower symbol to the junction with Northway and Paradise Meadows (~(836,1068)). Uncertain part: the first ~70 px; the trail may instead start at the band just below the upper symbol (~(1020,845)), i.e. as the continuation of Purgatory.

Square (1011,784) sits in the narrow channel between the thin diagonal tree row (~(970,768)-(1005,815)) and the tree island carrying the Purgatory and Hell's Crossing labels. Short connector: traced from the Northway band at (986,748) down that channel to where it opens into the wide band below the island (~(1040,845)), at Hell's Crossing / Angel's Wiggle.

Square (1125,572) at the start of a narrow cat-track strip (pink uphill route on it) that leaves the saddle at the foot of Vermonter and runs ESE just under the label, between the tree mass above and the Catwalk tree island below, to the Northway traverse at (1300,622). Traced along the strip centre, ~5 px below the pink dashes.

Both squares, (1716,193) (label printed just above the yellow boundary) and (1162,479), are on the open strip along the ridge crest just under the boundary's row of trees. Traced from the summit (tram top ~(2038,123)) west down that strip, past the tops of Valhalla and Green Beret, to the saddle (~(1073,535)) where it meets Montrealer (the ridge strip continuing west with the pink route), Catwalk (east) and a wide unlabelled open slope running south to Northway at ~(1100,700). Stopped at the saddle: the map does not show whether Vermonter continues down that slope.

Printed three times: squares at (1195,738), (1182,864) and (960,1050) (the task's (1276,801) is the mean of the two printed labels (1282,738) and (1269,864)). Traced from the Northway junction at the pink route's hook (1128,688) down the channel east of the Purgatory tree island to the hairpin at (1278,820) (junction with Upper/Lower Milk Run and Taxi), back west along the wide band below the island (pink route) to ~(1070,912), then down the right-hand of the two parallel strips there (a thin row of brown trees separates it from Hell's Crossing's strip; the lower symbol (960,1050) is on it) to where the strips merge into Paradise Meadows at ~(843,1163).

NO CUT: the diamond (1389,478) and name sit in a gladed slope of sparse painted trees between the Vermonter ridge strip and the open S-shaped cut that carries the Green Beret diamond (1535,438); no open cut runs through the Valhalla label. The sparse band runs from Vermonter at ~(1425,352) through (1417,440) and (1398,490), then narrows down-left via (1348,538) and (1326,584) to Northway at ~(1308,614), if a line is wanted along it. The white S-cut (ridge ~(1520,320) -> (1530,440) -> (1462,530) -> Northway ~(1490,590)) was left to Green Beret because its diamond sits in that cut.

Square (1126,1024) sits on the open strip along the lower edge of the long dark-green tree band that runs from the Angel's Wiggle hairpin down-left toward Paradise Meadows. Traced from the junction where Upper Milk Run meets the Angel's Wiggle hairpin (~(1310,838), under the Angel's Wiggle label), down the west side of the Taxi opening, down-left along that strip through the label, then down the S-shaped white opening west of the Bonaventure Glade symbol and the strip below it to the top of the green-dot slow zone (~(968,1212)) above Kangaroo Trail. The upper half is clear; below the label it runs through gladed terrain with several parallel openings, so the lower half is less certain.
